name: Reuters & AP
description: Wire reporting on AI companies, government decisions, and international developments.
notes: Discovery through Google News; publisher metadata is restricted to Reuters and AP. Open the original report before drawing conclusions.

name: OpenAI
description: Original product announcements, research releases, and company policies.
notes: Primary evidence of what OpenAI says; performance and safety claims need outside scrutiny.

name: OpenAI on YouTube
description: Product demonstrations, launch presentations, and conversations from OpenAI’s official channel.
notes: Produced by OpenAI. Videos open on YouTube; the feed contains recent uploads, not the full channel archive.

name: MIT Technology Review
description: Context on AI research, industry incentives, and policy.
notes: Some articles require a subscription. Feed items tagged sponsored are excluded.

name: Simon Willison
description: Hands-on experiments, useful tools, implementation details, and prompt-injection analysis.
notes: Personal analysis and selected links. Only posts tagged AI, LLMs, or generative AI enter this feed.

name: 404 Media
description: Original reporting on AI abuse, privacy, labor, and the effects on people.
notes: Some articles require registration or a paid subscription. Headlines may include allegations; read the underlying evidence.

name: METR
description: Empirical work on agent capabilities, safety evaluations, and developer productivity.
notes: Research nonprofit with disclosed lab partnerships and model access. Evaluations measure specified settings, not universal safety.

name: The Guardian
description: AI policy, social impact, and reporting beyond Silicon Valley.
notes: Includes opinion and podcasts; assess the format of each item.

name: The Verge
description: Product coverage, accountability reporting, and industry interviews.
notes: The full AI desk feed avoids missing consequential stories that omit OpenAI from the headline.

name: TechCrunch
notes: Funding announcements are not proof of customer value or profit.

name: Ars Technica
description: Technical AI reporting, security, and policy context.
notes: Some coverage is subscriber-only; verify important claims against underlying sources.

name: One Useful Thing
description: Ethan Mollick on using AI in work and education.
notes: A named author’s interpretation and experiments; recommendations can age as products change.

name: AI Now Institute
description: Research and policy advocacy on concentrated power and accountability.
notes: Includes advocacy, press appearances, and organizational updates; distinguish each from original research.

name: Alignment Forum
description: Technical alignment arguments and discussion from researchers.
notes: Posts are not automatically peer-reviewed or representative of a scientific consensus.

name: OpenAI Status
description: Official incident history and service updates.
notes: An incident headline may describe a resolved issue. Check the linked current status.
